response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience and strong technical leadership across diverse domains, including AI-agent infrastructure, real-time systems, and geospatial platforms. However, his lack of direct experience with large-scale experimentation/measurement platforms, statistical methods for experimentation, or AI-driven growth systems reduces his immediate fit for this principal-level role. His strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on coding are positives, but the role requires deeper expertise in experimentation frameworks and cross-team influence at scale.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with experience in distributed systems and real-time applications
Proven track record of building scalable platforms (e.g., GISCollective, re:cinq AI-agent tools)
Hands-on coding and technical leadership in multiple languages and domains
concerns: No explicit experience building experimentation/measurement platforms or feature-flagging systems
Limited evidence of working with statistical methods for experimentation or bias detection
No direct experience with high-scale A/B testing or growth systems at an enterprise level
